name: WBS Power Baltic Data Center Campus, Lublewo/Choczewo
notes: Company release says a hyperscale campus named Baltic Data Center Campus will be developed in Lublewo, Choczewo municipality, Pomerania, with target capacity 3.2 GW, secured grid-connection conditions, four 800 MW phases, preparatory work through 2027, and first data center expected around 2028-2029.

name: Lyten AI data center, Gdansk port industrial hub
notes: Trade press reports Lyten announced plans to build an AI data center in Gdansk as part of a wider industrial hub around an existing BESS and R&D facility serving AI, defense, and energy infrastructure sectors; capacity not disclosed.

name: PLAY / 3S Gdansk data center, Nowy Swiat 40
notes: 3S announced opening its seventh facility in Gdansk at ul. Nowy Swiat 40; reported at 1.2 MW, over 500 sqm, and up to 180 racks. Facility directories now list it under PLAY/3S.

name: Artnet Data Centers, Gdansk and Gdynia
notes: Operator page says Artnet has two independent Tier III-class data centers in the Tri-City: Gdansk at Marynarki Polskiej 100 and Gdynia at Chwaszczynska 133A. Baxtel lists Pomeranian Voivodeship market presence and identifies Artnet Gdynia as the largest local facility by listed floor area.

name: LVL Energy data center with BESS, Tucznawa investment zone, Dabrowa Gornicza
notes: Municipal announcement says LVL Energy bought a 3.9282 ha plot in Tucznawa for a modern data processing center plus about 200 MW battery storage; implementation is planned for 2026-2030, with operations planned in early 2031. DCD reports the data center component as 50 MW.

name: DL Invest Group / Boosteroid data center, Bielsko-Biala
notes: DCD reports DL Invest Group selected Bielsko-Biala as the first location in a planned European data-center network under its Boosteroid JV, with completion predicted by 2028. Facility-directory coverage identifies the site as a planned 50 MW data center at Eugeniusza Kwiatkowskiego 71B.

name: 3S Data Center Katowice DC3, Gospodarcza complex
notes: 3S announced DC3 beside its DC1/DC2 Katowice complex, adding 2,200 sqm and taking the Gospodarcza campus to 4,400 sqm; it was due to enter operation in Q1 2023. Baxtel lists the Katowice campus as operational and notes DC3 year built 2023.

name: 3S / PLAY Bytom-Szymaly data center
notes: 3S disclosed a 750 sqm Bytom data center in final opening/adaptation stage alongside its Katowice DC3 investment; Data Center Map lists PLAY Bytom DC at Szymaly 153 as a current facility.

name: Orange Polska Kielce data center / interconnection facility
notes: Inflect lists Orange Business Services Kielce at Al. IX Wiekow Kielc 14 as a data center with colocation and network connectivity; PeeringDB facility record confirms Orange Polska Kielce interconnection presence. Capacity not published.

name: Netia Dzialoszyce data center
notes: Facility marketplace listing identifies a Netia-operated data center in Dzialoszyce, Poland, with colocation and internet-access services. No primary source or capacity found during this pass.

name: Sprint Data Center, Olsztyn
notes: Sprint's official pages describe Sprint Data Center services from Olsztyn, with company address at ul. Jagiellonczyka 26; Polish page states the main Olsztyn server room is ready for 60 42U racks and includes high-power sector, access control, backup generator, cooling, and VESDA fire detection.

name: Orange Polska Olsztyn data center / interconnection facility
notes: Inflect and Datacenterplatform list Orange Polska Olsztyn at Jaroszyka 21 as an operational data center/interconnection location. Capacity not published.

name: Beyond.pl Data Center 2, Poznan
notes: Beyond.pl official facility page states DC2 in Poznan at A. Kreglewskiego 11 has 42 MW IT load, 53 MW total power allocation, 9,400 sqm total floor space, 2,000 sqm IT space, and ANSI/TIA-942 Rated 4 plus EN 50600 Class 4 certifications.

name: Beyond.pl Poznan Data Center Campus expansion
notes: Beyond.pl announced preparation of its Poznan campus to support 150 MW, adding new AI-oriented colocation capacity on the existing campus. Current homepage continues to describe a multi-tier 150 MW campus.

name: Beyond.pl Data Center 1, Poznan
notes: Beyond.pl official DC1 page lists the Poznan facility at Polwiejska 42 with 800 sqm total floor space, 400 sqm IT floor space, Tier III-compliant site standard, PUE 1.4, and 99.982% SLA. Capacity not published.

name: Orange Polska Szczecin data center / interconnection facility
notes: Multiple facility/interconnection directories list Orange Polska Szczecin at Niepodleglosci 41/42 as an operational data center/colocation facility. Capacity not published.

name: Asseco Cloud / Asseco Data Systems Szczecin data center
notes: Asseco announcement says one of its data centers is located in Szczecin while announcing Asseco Cloud headquarters there. Data Center Map lists Asseco Szczecin at Krolowej Korony Polskiej 21 as a Tier 3 facility with colocation/cloud services. Capacity not published.
